scientific_limitations: Only rank-four first-order adjacency/equality of unlabeled simply laced Dynkin graphs A, D, E is classified.
The finite enumeration is computationally reproducible but not externally formalized; infinite range uses a separate mathematical game lemma.
The A-series threshold was already known from Brown and Hoshino (2007).
No exhaustive survey of unpublished work or independent mathematical audit has been performed.
